vo.l01: Tonight... two million years of evolution, settled in one ring.
vo.l02: In the red corner... Homo erectus! He walked the Earth for almost two million years. The first human to leave Africa, and probably the first to cook with fire.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... Homo sapiens! Only 300,000 years old, but with a brain almost 50% bigger.
vo.l04: Fun fact: erectus had shoulders built for throwing. You do not want to eat that right hand.
vo.l05: Ohh! This guy survived ice ages and saber-toothed cats.
vo.l06: But sapiens has something erectus never had... a plan.
vo.l11: But remember: erectus lasted almost two million years. We've made it to 300,000. Check back in a million.
